title: ToonStudio automated operational validation

claimPolicy.reason: Deterministic tests and committed historical evidence validate bounded contracts. Current-commit eight-hour soak, physical devices, real browser faults, and signed professional evaluation remain external release gates.

lanes.title: Resource budgets and historical eight-hour soak evidence
lanes.outcome: Performance plans preserve originals, robust leak analysis rejects growth, and the committed eight-hour pass and leak-regression fixture remain distinguishable.

lanes.title: Shared professional drawing engine quality
lanes.outcome: Integrated Studio and ToonStudio Draw share bounded input prediction, stabilizer endpoint completion, pressure dynamics, device input profiles, live stylus feedback, large-canvas brush coverage, selection refinement and compositing semantics without creating a second editor authority.

lanes.title: Loss-visible PSD and CLIP round-trip contracts
lanes.outcome: PSD import/export, editable text, adjustment graphs, saved CLIP selections and workspace interchange preserve supported editable data and reject silent coercion.

lanes.title: Injected failure and collaboration recovery
lanes.outcome: Storage rejection, torn journals, corrupt snapshots, device loss, worker termination, queue inversion and offline retry preserve the durable prefix without duplicate commits.

lanes.title: Accessibility and security contract gates
lanes.outcome: Keyboard, touch target, contrast, reading order, mobile focus isolation, CSP and dependency advisory policies fail closed.

externalReleaseGates: Current-commit eight-hour soak on the release build
Physical pen-display and tablet sessions covering pressure, tilt, hover, barrel rotation, stylus buttons and palm rejection
Physical WebGPU device-loss and real browser worker termination matrix
Browser process crash and OPFS recovery on Safari, Chromium and Firefox release devices
